verdict.rationale: Rippling's own device management covers the Apple and Windows device lifecycle, including zero-touch deployment and setup, and enforces security policies built on user and device attributes. Devices and identity sit on one platform, which ties policy to identity. Remote lock/wipe is never mentioned, and all evidence is marketing-level vendor copy. missing for 10: documented remote lock/wipe, detailed enrollment/MDM technical docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, devices are managed from the same platform or a documented MDM integration — enrollment, policy enforcement, and remote lock/wipe tied to identity

citations.quote: Streamline device management with automations for the entire lifecycle of Apple and Windows devices.
Build and enforce custom security policies based on hundreds of user and device attributes.
Ship devices with the right software and security controls configured thanks to zero-touch deployment.
Streamline setup, configuration, and software install across macOS, Windows, iOS, and iPadOS devices, all in one place.
Unify identity, devices, and compliance on a system built for the AI era of IT.
